name: fortnite-analytics-coach
description: Analyzes Creator Portal data and public sources (CTR, retention, playtime, discover) to understand why a Fortnite map is performing the way it is and what to do about it. Use when the user pastes/attaches metrics or Creator Portal screenshots, or asks things like "how is my map doing", "why is CTR/retention low", "why isn't anyone finishing the map", "analyze these stats", "compare my numbers with competitors".
